name: casual
style: Modern mobile casual: chunky, bright, glossy, cartoon. Bold shapes, saturated colours, short and punchy. Not realistic, not gritty.
moduleNeeds: three >= 0.182 provided by the page through an import map

effects.name: hit.impact
effects.whenToUse: Something gets hit: a punch, a sword slash landing, a ball striking a block, a bullet hitting a wall.

effects.name: hit.slash
effects.whenToUse: A sword, claw or blade slash hits. Aim it along the swing: in 2D set dir (degrees, default down-right); in 3D pass direction: [x, y, z].

effects.name: hit.punch
effects.whenToUse: A punch, kick, headbutt or blunt hit lands. Bigger and rounder than hit.impact; good for boxing, brawlers, cartoon fights.

effects.name: hit.bullet
effects.whenToUse: A bullet, arrow, laser bolt or thrown pebble hits a surface or an enemy. Small and fast; can fire many times a second.

effects.name: hit.crit
effects.whenToUse: A critical hit, a super move landing, a weak-point strike, a headshot. Louder than hit.impact.

effects.name: hit.block
effects.whenToUse: A crate, brick, wall, rock or block is hit or breaks. Tint it the colour of the material (wood, stone, ice).

effects.name: hit.blood
effects.whenToUse: A creature takes a bloody hit in an action game. Aim it: in 2D set dir (degrees, default up); in 3D pass direction: [x, y, z], the way the blood flies (away from the weapon). Tint green for slime or zombies, black for oil or ink, purple for aliens.

effects.name: hit.shieldbreak
effects.whenToUse: A shield, barrier, bubble or armour breaks. Play where the shield was, then stop its state.shield loop.

effects.name: hit.parry
effects.whenToUse: A parry, a perfect block, a deflected bullet, swords clashing, a counter. Sharp and bright. Aim the spark spray: dir (degrees) in 2D, direction: [x, y, z] in 3D (default up).

effects.name: hit.shieldzap
effects.whenToUse: A shield, force field or energy barrier takes a hit: an energy bolt striking a shield, a shocking blow blocked, an electric barrier zapped.

effects.name: hit.dirt
effects.whenToUse: A bullet, arrow, shovel, hoof or heavy step hits soil, sand or grass: missed shots in a shooter, digging, a stomp on dirt. Play it on the ground where it hit. Tint it for sand, mud or snow.

effects.name: hit.ko
effects.whenToUse: A character is knocked out or defeated: K.O. in a fighting game, the player dies in a platformer, a boss goes down, an enemy is finished off. Play it on the character's body. For an enemy simply vanishing use explosion.puff.

effects.name: hit.flurry
effects.whenToUse: A rapid multi-hit attack: a punch flurry, a fast sword combo, a machine-gun burst on one target, a special move that hits several times. Play it once on the target; it lands four hits in under half a second.

effects.name: hit.kick
effects.whenToUse: A ball is kicked, hit or thrown hard: a soccer shot, a golf drive, a baseball hit, a power shot, a volleyball spike. Play it on the ball at the moment of the hit; in 2D set dir (degrees) and in 3D pass direction the way the ball flies. Then follow the ball with move.trail.

effects.name: hit.stomp
effects.whenToUse: The player jumps on an enemy's head, squashes a bug, ground-pounds a target or bounces off a foe in a platformer. Play it on top of the enemy as it gets squashed.

effects.name: hit.splat
effects.whenToUse: Something wet and sticky hits: a slime enemy squashed, a paint ball or paint shot, a tomato or egg thrown, ink, mud, honey or goo. Play it where it lands; tint it for the substance (green slime, paint colour, red tomato).

effects.name: hit.electric
effects.whenToUse: An electric or lightning attack lands: a taser, a shock trap, a thunder sword, a zapped enemy, an electric fence touched. Play it on the target. For a bolt from the sky use magic.lightning; for a shield being hit use hit.shieldzap.

effects.name: hit.fire
effects.whenToUse: A fire attack lands: a flaming sword, a fire punch, a fire arrow hit, a burn damage tick, touching lava. Play it on the target. For a fireball exploding use explosion.fireball; for staying on fire use state.burning.

effects.name: hit.ice
effects.whenToUse: An ice or frost attack lands: an ice arrow, a freeze punch, a cold blast, snowball impact, a frozen enemy struck. Play it on the target. For becoming frozen use state.frozen; for an ice spell burst use explosion.ice.

effects.name: hit.heavy
effects.whenToUse: A very heavy blow: a hammer smash, a giant's stomp, a body slam, a ground pound, a boss landing, a huge punch. Play it at the point of impact (on the ground for slams). Bigger and slower than hit.punch.

effects.name: hit.metal
effects.whenToUse: Metal hits metal: a sword on armour, a bullet on a steel wall, a robot struck, a shield bash, a pipe whacked, a blocked blade. Play it at the point of contact. For a successful parry use hit.parry.

effects.name: hit.arrow
effects.whenToUse: An arrow, crossbow bolt, dart or throwing knife thunks into something: an archery target hit, a bolt sticking in a wooden wall or shield, an arrow striking an enemy, a dart on a board; play it where it struck, in 2D set dir (degrees, default 90 = up) toward the side it came from and in 3D pass direction (for a bullet use hit.bullet, for an arrow into soil use hit.dirt, for a fire or ice arrow add hit.fire or hit.ice).

effects.name: hit.asteroid
effects.whenToUse: An asteroid, space rock, meteor or comet is shot and breaks apart in a space shooter or asteroid-mining game: play it where the rock was, once per rock destroyed (tint it for icy or crystal asteroids); for a rock mined with a pickaxe on the ground use gather.stone, for a crate or wall breaking use hit.block.

effects.name: hit.backstab
effects.whenToUse: A rogue, assassin, ninja or thief lands a sneak attack from behind or out of stealth: a backstab, an ambush, a shadow strike, an instant-kill stab; play it on the victim and set dir (degrees, default down-right) for the first slash, and for an ordinary critical hit use hit.crit instead.

effects.name: hit.bite
effects.whenToUse: A bite or chomp attack lands: a zombie, vampire, wolf, shark, snake, monster or pet bites a target, a bear trap or plant snaps shut, a hungry creature takes a bite. Play it on the target. For a claw rake use hit.claw; for a sword or blade use hit.slash; for a bleeding wound use hit.blood.

effects.name: hit.bonk
effects.whenToUse: Something bonks a character on the head in a funny cartoon way with no blood: a mallet, a frying pan, a falling coconut or anvil, a head bump, a slapstick hit; play it on top of the head, and follow it with state.stun if they stay dizzy.

effects.name: hit.brick
effects.whenToUse: A brick is smashed by the ball in a breakout, brick-breaker or arkanoid game, or a block is knocked out in an arcade block game; play it on the brick and tint it with the brick colour. For a crate, wall or rock broken in an action game use hit.block; for an enemy blown up in pixel art use explosion.pixel.

effects.name: hit.charge
effects.whenToUse: A cavalry, knight, bull, rhino or boar charge crashes into enemies: a mounted lance charge breaking a line, a shield rush, a boss bull-rush, a battering ram knocking soldiers flying in a medieval, strategy or brawler game. Play it where the charge hits; in 2D set dir (degrees, the way the charge travels, default 0 = right), in 3D pass direction. For two sports players colliding use hit.tackle; for a slam into the ground use hit.heavy; for a spear point use hit.thrust.

effects.name: hit.claw
effects.whenToUse: A beast, werewolf, cat, bear, dragon or monster rakes a target with its claws and leaves three parallel slash marks; play it on the target and set dir (degrees on screen, default down-right) to the way the paw swipes, and for a single sword or blade swing use hit.slash instead.

effects.name: hit.counter
effects.whenToUse: A counter-attack lands right after a block, parry or dodge: a riposte, a reversal, a perfect-timing strike back in a fighting or action game; play it on the enemy being hit, and for the block or parry itself use hit.parry instead.

effects.name: hit.dunk
effects.whenToUse: A ball goes through a hoop or ring: a basketball slam dunk or swish, a scoring shot in a hoop, ring-toss or ball-in-a-cup game, a paper ball into the bin. Play it at the centre of the hoop at the moment the ball drops through. For a big goal-scoring celebration on top use reward.goal.

effects.name: hit.elementfire
effects.whenToUse: A fire-enchanted weapon strikes: a flaming sword slash, a fire axe chop, a burning spear thrust, a blow from a weapon playing weapon.flamesword. Aim it along the swing: in 2D set dir (degrees, default down-right); in 3D pass direction: [x, y, z]. For a fire hit that is not a blade (a fire punch, a fire arrow, a burn tick) use hit.fire; for a plain blade use hit.slash.

effects.name: hit.elementice
effects.whenToUse: An ice-enchanted weapon strikes: a frost sword slash, an ice axe chop, a freezing spear thrust, a blow from a weapon playing weapon.frostblade. Aim it along the swing: in 2D set dir (degrees, default down-right); in 3D pass direction: [x, y, z]. For an ice hit that is not a blade (an ice arrow, a snowball, a freeze punch) use hit.ice; for a plain blade use hit.slash.

effects.name: hit.elementshock
effects.whenToUse: A lightning-enchanted weapon strikes: a thunder sword slash, a shock spear thrust, an electric hammer blow, a hit from a weapon playing weapon.thunderhammer. Aim it along the swing: in 2D set dir (degrees, default down-right); in 3D pass direction: [x, y, z]. For an electric hit that is not a blade (a taser, a shock trap, a zap) use hit.electric; for a plain blade use hit.slash.

effects.name: hit.emp
effects.whenToUse: An EMP, ion or disruptor shot hits a robot, drone, turret, vehicle or machine and shorts it out (it stops, stalls or is stunned): play it on the target; for a big area EMP blast use explosion.electric, for an electric attack on a living creature use hit.electric.

effects.name: hit.fur
effects.whenToUse: A furry creature or pet gets bopped in a cartoon scuffle: a cat fight, a dog tussle, a bonk in whack-a-mole, a fluffy monster or plush toy hit, a bear swatted. Play it on the creature; tint it to the fur colour (ginger, grey, brown, white). For a slapstick bonk on the head use hit.bonk; for a plain punch use hit.punch; for squashing an enemy from above use hit.stomp.

effects.name: hit.ghost
effects.whenToUse: A ghost, spirit or phantom touches or strikes something: a ghost enemy attacks, a haunted hand grabs, a spectral or soul-draining blow lands, a ghost flies through the player. Play it on the target. For an ice or frost attack use hit.ice; for a dark spell use magic.dark.

effects.name: hit.glass
effects.whenToUse: A window, glass pane, bottle, mirror, windshield, lamp or display case shatters: a ball through a window, a bullet hitting glass, a jar smashed. Play it on the glass. For a gem or glass tile in a puzzle use puzzle.shatter; for ice breaking use magic.ice.

effects.name: hit.golf
effects.whenToUse: A golf club hits the ball off the grass or tee: a drive, an iron shot, a chip, a mini-golf putt played hard. Play it at the ball on the ground at the moment of the swing; in 2D set dir (degrees, default a low 20 degrees up to the right) and in 3D pass direction the way the ball flies. Tint it sandy for a bunker shot. For a soccer kick use hit.kick.

effects.name: hit.homerun
effects.whenToUse: A bat smashes the ball as hard as it can: a baseball or cricket home run, a perfect power hit, a launch in a ball-hitting or slugger game. Play it on the ball at the moment of contact; in 2D set dir (degrees, default 45 up to the right) and in 3D pass direction the way the ball flies. Bigger than hit.kick; for a tennis or ping-pong hit use hit.racket.

effects.name: hit.laser
effects.whenToUse: A laser, blaster bolt, plasma shot or energy beam hits a wall, the ground, a hull or an enemy (sci-fi and space shooters, tower defence lasers, cutting beams): play it where it hits with dir in 2D (degrees, default 90 = up, the way the sparks fly off the surface) or direction in 3D, tinted the colour of the laser; for plain bullets use hit.bullet, for a hit on a force field use hit.shieldzap.

effects.name: hit.note
effects.whenToUse: A note, tile or beat is hit on time in a rhythm, piano-tile or music game: a lane key pressed on the beat, a drum pad hit, a music tile tapped. Play it on the note and tint it with the lane colour; add reward.perfect, reward.great or reward.good for the rating.

effects.name: hit.paddle
effects.whenToUse: A ball bounces off a paddle, bumper, flipper or wall in a breakout, pong, pinball or air-hockey game; play it at the contact point, and in 2D set dir (degrees) to the way the ball bounces away (default up), in 3D pass direction. For a ball kicked or struck hard in a sports game use hit.kick; for a character launched by a spring use move.bounce.

effects.name: hit.pie
effects.whenToUse: A cream pie, cake or custard tart is thrown and lands, usually in someone's face: comedy and party games, a clown act, a food fight, a birthday prank, a cake-smash mini-game. Play it where it lands; tint it for chocolate or fruit cream. For slime, paint, a tomato or an egg use hit.splat.

effects.name: hit.racket
effects.whenToUse: A player swings a racket or bat at a ball or shuttlecock in a racket sport: a tennis serve or return, a badminton smash, a ping-pong shot, a squash or padel hit, a volley. Play it on the ball at the moment of contact; in 2D set dir (degrees, default 0 = right) and in 3D pass direction the way the ball flies. For a ball bouncing off a breakout, pong or pinball paddle use hit.paddle; for a kicked ball use hit.kick; for a golf drive use hit.golf; for a baseball bat use hit.homerun.

effects.name: hit.robot
effects.whenToUse: A robot, drone, mech, turret or machine enemy takes a hit and loses bits (metal sparks, black oil smoke, loose bolts): play it on the robot at each hit; for a plain metal clang without debris use hit.metal, for an EMP that shorts it out use hit.emp, for a robot destroyed use explosion.small or explosion.electric.

effects.name: hit.shieldwall
effects.whenToUse: A sword, axe, club or spear strikes a raised wooden shield and is blocked: a shield wall holding, a knight or viking blocking, a hoplite taking a blow in a medieval, historical or RPG fight. Play it on the shield face, once per blow; in 2D set dir (degrees, the way splinters bounce off, default 90 = up), in 3D pass direction away from the shield. For an arrow sticking in the shield use hit.arrow; for metal on metal use hit.metal; for a perfect parry use hit.parry; for an energy shield use hit.shieldzap; when the shield breaks use hit.shieldbreak.

effects.name: hit.slow
effects.whenToUse: A frost or slowing shot lands and slows an enemy down: a frost tower in tower defense, a slowing trap or totem, a chill or frostbolt spell. Play it on the enemy each time a slowing hit lands. For an ice hit with flying shards use hit.ice; to show the enemy staying frozen use state.frozen.

effects.name: hit.sonic
effects.whenToUse: A shockwave punch, sonic boom, air blast, shout or roar attack, sound-wave cannon or super-speed impact that pushes the air out in rings; play it at the point of impact, and for a heavy blow on the ground use hit.heavy instead.

effects.name: hit.splashhit
effects.whenToUse: Something lands hard in shallow water, a puddle, a swamp or mud: a character landing or stomping in a puddle, a heavy hit on wet ground, a cannonball or boulder hitting the shallows, a ground pound in a marsh. Play it where it lands; tint it brown for mud. For falling into deep water use move.splash; for slime or goo use hit.splat; for dry ground use hit.dirt.

effects.name: hit.sweep
effects.whenToUse: A low sweeping kick, a leg sweep, a tail swipe or a spinning low attack along the floor that trips enemies; play it on the ground at the attacker's feet (dir: 0 sweeps to the right, 180 to the left), and for a hard slam straight down use hit.heavy (for sweeping with a broom, move.sweep).

effects.name: hit.tackle
effects.whenToUse: Two players crash into each other in a sports game: an American football tackle, a rugby hit, a hockey body check, a slide tackle, a sumo or bumper shove, a dodgeball player knocked down. Play it where the bodies meet. For a punch use hit.punch; for slamming into the ground use hit.heavy; for cars colliding use vehicle.crash.

effects.name: hit.thrust
effects.whenToUse: A spear, lance, rapier, pike, trident or horn stabs straight into a target; play it on the target and aim it the way the point travels with dir in 2D (degrees, default right) or direction: [x, y, z] in 3D, and for a sideways sword swing use hit.slash instead.

effects.name: hit.upgradefail
effects.whenToUse: An upgrade, enchant, craft, forge or fusion attempt fails; a recipe is wrong; a gacha roll gives a dud. Play it on the item: a sad little puff, more comic than tragic. For a successful upgrade use reward.upgrade; for something really breaking use hit.shieldbreak or hit.block; for a plain vanish use explosion.puff.

effects.name: hit.water
effects.whenToUse: A water attack hits a target: a water gun or squirt, a water bolt or bubble spell, a hose or wave blast striking an enemy; play it on the target and aim the spray with dir (degrees, default up) or direction: [x, y, z] in 3D, and for falling into water use move.splash or for a water bomb explosion.water instead.

effects.name: explosion.small
effects.whenToUse: A small thing blows up: a barrel, an enemy, a car crash, a bomb, a rocket landing. About 150px wide.

effects.name: explosion.big
effects.whenToUse: A boss dies, a building or tank blows up, a big bomb goes off, a level-ending blast. Twice the size of explosion.small.

effects.name: explosion.puff
effects.whenToUse: Something vanishes, pops or gets squashed without fire: an enemy poofing away, a balloon, a magic disappearance, a cartoon collision.

effects.name: explosion.fireball
effects.whenToUse: A fire spell lands, a fuel can ignites, a dragon breath hits, a torch bursts. Fire without the smoke of an explosion.

effects.name: explosion.firework
effects.whenToUse: Celebrations and fun blasts: fireworks on a win screen, a party popper, a magic burst. Tint it or leave it multicolour.

effects.name: explosion.nuke
effects.whenToUse: A bomb power-up clears the board, a super attack wipes every enemy, the final boss dies. Covers the whole screen; play once.

effects.name: explosion.pixel
effects.whenToUse: An explosion, enemy death or block break in a pixel-art, retro, 8-bit or arcade-style game, where soft glowing effects would look out of place. Tint it for non-fire blasts (null keeps the fire colours).

effects.name: explosion.ice
effects.whenToUse: An ice bomb, a frost nova, a freezing spell exploding, an ice crystal shattering into a blast, a snow grenade. Play it at the centre. Freeze nearby enemies with state.frozen.

effects.name: explosion.electric
effects.whenToUse: An EMP, a shock bomb, a tesla coil discharge, an overloaded generator blowing, a lightning spell exploding, a robot shorting out. Play it at the centre.

effects.name: explosion.toxic
effects.whenToUse: A gas grenade, a poison bomb, a toxic barrel bursting, a stink bomb, a zombie or mutant exploding, an acid blob popping. Play it at the centre. For a small poison attack use magic.poison.

effects.name: explosion.magic
effects.whenToUse: A magic spell explodes or is unleashed: an arcane blast, a wizard's area attack, a cursed object bursting, a magic crystal overloading, a fairy explosion. Play it at the centre; tint it for the school of magic.

effects.name: explosion.water
effects.whenToUse: A water balloon or water bomb bursts, a big wave hits, something huge falls into water, a geyser erupts, a depth charge goes off. Play it at the centre (on the water surface for falls). For a small splash use move.splash.

effects.name: explosion.artillery
effects.whenToUse: An artillery, mortar or cannon shell lands and blasts a crater in the ground: a cannonball or catapult boulder impact in tower defense, an airstrike or bombardment hit, a bomb going off in the dirt. Play it on the ground where it lands. It is wide and low with a crown of dirt; for a tall column straight up out of the ground (a landmine, a fire geyser) use explosion.mine, and for a blast in the air or of an object (a barrel, an enemy) use explosion.small.

effects.name: explosion.balloon
effects.whenToUse: A balloon pops: a balloon-popping or dart game, a party balloon shot or stepped on, a bubble-gum bubble bursting, a floating balloon enemy bursting with a bang. Tint it the balloon's colour. For a water balloon use explosion.water; for a smoky cartoon poof use explosion.puff; for many small bubbles in a bubble shooter use puzzle.bubble.

effects.name: explosion.barrel
effects.whenToUse: An explosive red barrel, a fuel drum, a gas tank or propane canister blows up: the classic shooter and action-game hazard, a car fuel tank going up. Play it at the barrel's centre. For a generic small blast use explosion.small; for a green toxic barrel use explosion.toxic.

effects.name: explosion.bass
effects.whenToUse: A bass drop or a heavy blast of sound: the drop in a music or rhythm game, a subwoofer or speaker blast, a DJ's power move, a beat that shakes the dance floor, a sound-based attack. Play it at the centre (it rolls out along the floor in 3D). For a pure energy blast use explosion.shockwave.

effects.name: explosion.candy
effects.whenToUse: A sweet, colourful burst in a candy or match-3 game: a colour bomb or wrapped candy going off, a candy jar or pinata breaking, a sweet booster used, a cute enemy popping into sweets. Play it at the centre; tint it for one colour or leave it multicolour. For one cleared tile use puzzle.match; for a row-and-column blast use puzzle.blast; for a big combo use reward.bigcombo.

effects.name: explosion.catapult
effects.whenToUse: A catapult, trebuchet or siege boulder smashes into a castle wall, tower, gate or rock face: a siege hit with flying stone chunks, grey dust and a shock ring, and no fire. Play it where the stone strikes. For a fiery shell or cannonball landing in the dirt use explosion.artillery; for a whole wall or building collapsing use explosion.dust; for a pickaxe chipping rock use gather.stone; for the launch use weapon.catapult.

effects.name: explosion.chain
effects.whenToUse: A chain reaction: a row of barrels or mines going off in turn, a cluster bomb, a big machine, tank or boss breaking apart before it dies, a string of firecrackers. Play it once at the centre; five pops ripple around it over half a second. For one single blast use explosion.small or explosion.big.

effects.name: explosion.dust
effects.whenToUse: A building, tower, wall or bridge collapses, a cave or tunnel caves in, a demolition, a rockslide or giant boulder crashes down: a big rolling dust cloud with rubble and no fire. Play it on the ground at the base. For a fiery blast use explosion.big; for a small landing puff use move.land.

effects.name: explosion.glitter
effects.whenToUse: A party popper or glitter bomb goes off at a spot: a gift or surprise box bursting, a birthday or party moment, a cute enemy popping into glitter, a prize or booster bursting open in a casual game. Tint it for one colour or leave it multicolour. For fireworks in the sky use explosion.firework; for a big win confetti cannon use reward.confetti.

effects.name: explosion.gunpowder
effects.whenToUse: A gunpowder keg, powder barrel or powder magazine blows up, or a cannonball or black-powder bomb bursts: pirate ships, castle sieges, westerns, medieval and historical games. Play it at the centre of the keg or where the ball bursts. Fiery orange with thick black smoke and wooden splinters; for a red fuel barrel use explosion.barrel, for a shell landing in the dirt use explosion.artillery, for a round cartoon bomb use explosion.small.

effects.name: explosion.mine
effects.whenToUse: A landmine, a buried trap or pressure plate, a hidden ground bomb, a fire geyser bursting from below: anything that blows up out of the ground in a tall column. Play it on the ground. For a shell, cannonball or bomb landing from above use explosion.artillery; for a blast in the air use explosion.small; for a meteor falling from the sky use magic.meteor.

effects.name: explosion.paint
effects.whenToUse: A paint bomb, paint balloon or paint bucket bursts: a paintball or splat game, a colour-war or Holi festival moment, an art or painting game, a cute monster popping into paint. Tint it for one colour or leave it multicolour. For a single goo or paint hit use hit.splat; for a colour bomb in a match-3 game use explosion.candy.

effects.name: explosion.ship
effects.whenToUse: A spaceship, fighter, UFO, drone, mech or space station is destroyed in a space shooter or sci-fi game (an enemy ship shot down, the player ship lost, a boss ship finished off): play it at the ship's centre (tint null keeps fire and a cyan ring, a tint recolours it all); for an explosion on the ground use explosion.small or explosion.big.

effects.name: explosion.shockwave
effects.whenToUse: A pure energy blast with no fire: a force push, a pulse grenade, a power-up released in a wave that knocks enemies back, a sci-fi reactor pulse, a super move unleashed. Play it at the centre; tint it for the energy colour. For a punch, shout or sonic boom pushing air out in rings use hit.sonic; for a slam on the ground use hit.heavy; for an electric EMP use explosion.electric; for a spell blast use explosion.magic.

effects.name: explosion.smokebomb
effects.whenToUse: A ninja or thief vanishes or appears in a burst of thick smoke: a smoke bomb thrown to escape, a magician's disappearing trick, a character poofing away behind a cloud. Play it on the character and hide or move them while the cloud is thick. For a small quick poof use explosion.puff; for a dark shadow-step blink use move.shadowstep; for a lasting smoke screen use weapon.smoke.

effects.name: explosion.soul
effects.whenToUse: Souls or spirits are released: a ghost or undead enemy is destroyed, a haunted object is purified, a spirit jar or cursed vessel shatters, a soul-collecting attack bursts, a curse is broken. Play it at the centre. For a magic blast use explosion.magic; for a few soul orbs being collected use pickup.xp.

effects.name: explosion.supernova
effects.whenToUse: A star or a giant space object explodes: a sun going supernova, a planet or space station destroyed in a space game, a cosmic super attack, a galaxy-level boss finally dying; play it at the centre (for an ordinary spaceship blowing up use explosion.ship, for a screen-clearing bomb use explosion.nuke).

effects.name: pickup.sparkle
effects.whenToUse: The player collects a coin, gem, star, key, heart or any small item. Also for a star earned on a result screen.

effects.name: pickup.coin
effects.whenToUse: A coin or money is collected. More "coin" than pickup.sparkle: a little coin pops up and fades. Also for a cash reward.

effects.name: pickup.gem
effects.whenToUse: A gem, diamond, crystal or premium currency is collected. Tint it to the gem colour (purple, green, red).

effects.name: pickup.heart
effects.whenToUse: A heart, life or health item is collected, a pet is petted, a character is happy or in love.

effects.name: pickup.powerup
effects.whenToUse: A power-up, booster, mushroom, shield or weapon upgrade is collected. Bigger and louder than a coin.

effects.name: pickup.xp
effects.whenToUse: Experience, mana, energy or souls are gained. Soft orbs float up from the point. Tint to the resource colour.

effects.name: pickup.key
effects.whenToUse: A key, a pass, a ticket or an access card is collected; a door unlocks.

effects.name: pickup.food
effects.whenToUse: A character eats food, a pet is fed, a potion of stamina is drunk, a snack is collected. Tint to the food colour.

effects.name: pickup.star
effects.whenToUse: A star is collected: level stars, a platformer collectible, a rating star earned in play, a bonus star. Play it where the star was. For the 1-3 stars on a results screen use ui.star.

effects.name: pickup.mana
effects.whenToUse: Mana, energy or stamina is restored: a mana potion, an energy drink, a blue orb picked up, a battery collected, magic power recharged. Play it on the character. For health use pickup.heart or magic.heal.

effects.name: pickup.armor
effects.whenToUse: Armour, a shield plate or extra protection is picked up: an armour vest in a shooter, a shield potion, a defence boost, a hull repair. Play it on the character. For an active shield bubble use state.shield.

effects.name: pickup.bomb
effects.whenToUse: A bomb, dynamite, TNT or grenade item is collected into the inventory, or a bomb power-up is picked up (nothing explodes). Play it where the item was. For the blast itself use explosion.small or explosion.big; for a thrown smoke bomb use weapon.smoke.

effects.name: pickup.fuel
effects.whenToUse: Fuel, gas or energy cells are collected in a space, flying or driving game: a fuel canister, a jerry can, an energy cell, a power cell, a battery pack or a fuel orb refilling the tank; play it where the item was or on the ship (for magic mana use pickup.mana, for XP orbs use pickup.xp).

effects.name: pickup.life
effects.whenToUse: An extra life is collected: a 1-UP, a green mushroom, an extra-try heart, one more life added to the lives counter. Play it where the item was. For a health refill, a love moment or a pet use pickup.heart; for a healing spell use magic.heal.

effects.name: pickup.multiball
effects.whenToUse: A multi-ball, split-ball, triple-shot or clone power-up is caught or fires: the ball splits into several in a breakout or pinball game, a shot splits in a shooter. Play it where the power-up was caught or the ball split. For any other power-up use pickup.powerup.

effects.name: pickup.shard
effects.whenToUse: A gem shard, crystal fragment, soul shard, star piece or other small fragment is collected, often many in a row (collect 10 shards to unlock a hero). Play it where the shard was; tint it to the shard colour. For a whole gem or premium currency use pickup.gem.

effects.name: pickup.speed
effects.whenToUse: A speed boost item is picked up: a lightning-bolt power-up, sprint shoes, a turbo or energy can in a runner or racing game. Play it where the item was; in 2D set dir (the way the player runs, default right), in 3D pass direction. For the speed lines while the boost lasts use move.speed or vehicle.nitro; for a boost pad on the track use world.boostpad.

effects.name: pickup.time
effects.whenToUse: Extra time is picked up in a timed level: a clock, an hourglass, a stopwatch or a "+5 s" item in a runner, puzzle or arcade game. Play it where the item was. For a slow-motion, rewind or time-stop spell use magic.time.

effects.name: pickup.treat
effects.whenToUse: A pet is given a treat as a reward: a dog biscuit for a trick, a fish for a cat, a carrot for a bunny, a snack in a pet-care, pet-training or virtual-pet game. Play it at the pet's mouth; tint it to the treat colour. For a character eating a meal or collecting food use pickup.food.

effects.name: reward.confetti
effects.whenToUse: A win: level complete, new record, chest opened, prize claimed. Fire it from the bottom or the middle of the screen; in 3D from the ground or a cannon, with direction: [x, y, z] to aim it (default straight up).

effects.name: reward.levelup
effects.whenToUse: The player levels up, upgrades an item, unlocks something, or completes a big milestone. Play on the character or the item.

effects.name: reward.starburst
effects.whenToUse: A star is earned, a perfect score, a combo milestone, a badge unlocked. Punchier than pickup.sparkle.

effects.name: reward.combo
effects.whenToUse: A combo counter goes up, a chain reaction step, a rapid hit streak. Short enough to fire several times a second. Tint by combo level.

effects.name: reward.chest
effects.whenToUse: A chest, crate, gift box, egg or loot bag opens. Play on the box; the rays shine upward.

effects.name: reward.coinshower
effects.whenToUse: A big money reward: jackpot, chest of coins, level payout, daily bonus. Covers the whole screen from the top.

effects.name: reward.clear
effects.whenToUse: Level complete, stage clear, game won. A whole-screen celebration. Play once when the result screen appears.

effects.name: reward.checkpoint
effects.whenToUse: The player reaches a checkpoint, a save point, a flag, a respawn point or a goal post. Play it at the checkpoint's base. For finishing a whole level use reward.clear.

effects.name: reward.jackpot
effects.whenToUse: A big win: a slot or casino jackpot, a lucky spin, a huge payout in an idle or clicker game, a treasure vault opening. Play it at the centre of the win. For a normal coin pickup use pickup.coin; for coins falling from the top use reward.coinshower.

effects.name: reward.goal
effects.whenToUse: A big scoring moment in a sports or party game: a goal, a touchdown, a basket, a hole-in-one, a strike, a finish-line win. Play it at the goal or the centre of the screen. For a plain level win use reward.clear.

effects.name: reward.rankup
effects.whenToUse: The player is promoted: a new rank, league or tier, a higher division, a battle-pass tier, a prestige level, a title earned. Play it at the centre of the rank badge. For a character level-up use reward.levelup.

effects.name: reward.bigcombo
effects.whenToUse: A huge combo or chain: a 10x combo, a long chain reaction, a fever or frenzy mode starting, a combo record. Play it at the centre of the combo text. Rainbow by default; a tint makes it one colour. For each small combo step use reward.combo; for a win or hot streak use reward.streak; for a match-3 special tile firing use puzzle.blast.

effects.name: reward.birthday
effects.whenToUse: A birthday or party moment: a birthday reward or login gift, a cake is served or candles blown out, a party starts, an anniversary, a friend or pet celebrating in a social or life-sim game. Play it on the character, the cake or the centre of the screen. For a plain win use reward.confetti; for a party popper or glitter bomb going off at a spot use explosion.glitter; for a whole fireworks show use reward.fireworkshow.

effects.name: reward.cardreveal
effects.whenToUse: A card, item or character is flipped over or revealed: a card pack opening, a gacha result card turning, a new item shown on a reward screen, a scratch card uncovered. Play it on the card (in 2D pass { el } so the shine fits the card); tint by rarity. For an everyday card flip in a card, memory or solitaire game use ui.cardflip; for a passing glint on a button use ui.shine; for the rarity burst add reward.rare or reward.legendary.

effects.name: reward.cheer
effects.whenToUse: A crowd or audience cheers: fans go wild after a great play, a stage show or dance ends, a talent or rhythm game scores big, a streamer gets hyped, a parade passes. Play it below the moment (the bottom of the screen in 2D, at the crowd or the front of the stage in 3D); things are thrown up from a wide line. For a burst from one point use reward.birthday; for a confetti cannon use reward.confetti.

effects.name: reward.clean
effects.whenToUse: Something becomes clean, washed or polished: a dish washed, a floor mopped, a car or window cleaned, a stain removed, a room tidied in a cleaning, makeover or pet-care game. Play it on the cleaned thing and size it to the object. For a shine across a button use ui.shine; for an item that keeps sparkling use state.sparkle.

effects.name: reward.cooked
effects.whenToUse: A dish or meal finishes cooking in a cooking, restaurant or farm game: food comes out of the oven, a recipe is completed, an order is plated and ready to serve, a cake is baked. Play it on the dish. For eating food use pickup.food; for picking a crop use gather.harvest.

effects.name: reward.encore
effects.whenToUse: The end of a song with a full combo or a top grade in a rhythm or music game: an all-perfect run, a song cleared with an S rank, a concert finale, a dance-off won. Play it once at the centre of the screen or the stage. For a plain level win use reward.clear, for one perfect note use reward.perfect.

effects.name: reward.finish
effects.whenToUse: A racer crosses the finish line: the end of a car, kart, bike, horse or running race, a final lap, a swim or ski race finish, a runner game reaching the goal. Play it on the finish line (or the centre of the screen) as the winner crosses. For a goal, basket or touchdown use reward.goal; for a plain level win use reward.clear.

effects.name: reward.fireworkshow
effects.whenToUse: A grand celebration that deserves a whole show: New Year, a festival night, a championship or tournament won, a park or castle closing show, a wedding. Play it on the ground under the show (or low on the screen); the rockets climb 200-340 px before they burst. For a single firework use explosion.firework; for a full win screen with confetti use reward.clear.

effects.name: reward.gift
effects.whenToUse: A present is unwrapped: a daily or login gift, a birthday or holiday present, a surprise box, a free reward in gift wrap. Play it on the box; tint it the ribbon colour. For a treasure chest or loot crate use reward.chest; for a gift claimed on a UI button use ui.burst.

effects.name: reward.good
effects.whenToUse: A GOOD rating in a rhythm or timing game: a note hit a little early or late, an okay tap or landing that still counts. Small and quick, safe on every note. For better timing use reward.great or reward.perfect, for a miss use ui.miss.

effects.name: reward.great
effects.whenToUse: A GREAT rating in a rhythm or timing game: a note hit just off perfect, a very good tap, release or landing. Play it where the note was hit. For a PERFECT hit use reward.perfect, for a weaker GOOD hit use reward.good, for a miss use ui.miss.

effects.name: reward.legendary
effects.whenToUse: A legendary or ultra-rare result: a 5-star gacha pull, a legendary or mythic item from a chest, the best card in a pack, the top prize of a draw. Play it on the item or at the centre of the reveal. For a rare (blue) result use reward.rare; for the summon beam itself use reward.summon; for a money win use reward.jackpot.

effects.name: reward.perfect
effects.whenToUse: A PERFECT timing moment: a perfect tap or release, a bullseye, a flawless landing or stack, a perfect note in a rhythm game, an exact drop in a timing or stacking hypercasual game. Play it where the perfect action happened. For one step of a combo use reward.combo; for a star earned use reward.starburst.

effects.name: reward.rare
effects.whenToUse: A rare (blue-tier) item, card or character is revealed: a rare drop, a 4-star pull, a rare card in a pack, a better-than-usual loot roll. Play it on the item; tint it for other tiers (green uncommon, purple epic). For a legendary use reward.legendary; for collecting a gem use pickup.gem.

effects.name: reward.record
effects.whenToUse: A new high score or personal best: a NEW RECORD banner on the results screen, beating your best distance, time or score, reaching the top of the leaderboard. Play it on the score. For a rank or league promotion use reward.rankup; for a whole-screen level win use reward.clear.

effects.name: reward.sticker
effects.whenToUse: A sticker, stamp or badge is earned in a kids or learning game: a gold star for a finished worksheet or lesson, a good-job stamp, a sticker book page filled, a daily streak sticker. Play it where the sticker appears. For a score milestone or perfect round use reward.starburst; for the 1-3 rating stars on a results screen use ui.star.

effects.name: reward.streak
effects.whenToUse: A win streak or hot streak: the player is "on fire", several wins or perfect hits in a row, a kill streak, the streak counter going up. Play it on the streak counter or the character. For one step of a combo use reward.combo; for something that keeps burning use state.burning.

effects.name: reward.summon
effects.whenToUse: A gacha pull or banner summon: a hero, card, pet or unit is summoned, a wish is made, a recruit arrives. Play it where the new character will stand and tint it by rarity (blue rare, purple epic, gold legendary); add reward.legendary for a top pull. For a spell that summons a creature in battle use magic.summon.

effects.name: reward.trophy
effects.whenToUse: A trophy, cup, medal or prize is won: a tournament or championship victory, first place on the podium, a season title, an achievement trophy unlocked. Play it on the trophy or medal (or the centre of the result screen). Tint silver or bronze for 2nd and 3rd place. For a rank or league promotion use reward.rankup; for a level-up use reward.levelup; for crossing a finish line use reward.finish.

effects.name: reward.unbox
effects.whenToUse: A loot box, mystery box, gacha capsule, supply crate or reward egg pops open in one quick burst: battle-pass rewards, crate openings in shooters, capsule toys. Play it on the box and tint it to the box rarity (the coins stay gold). For a treasure chest with light rays rising use reward.chest; for the item reveal that follows use reward.cardreveal, reward.rare or reward.legendary.

effects.name: reward.upgrade
effects.whenToUse: An item, weapon, building or card is upgraded, crafted or forged successfully: +1 on gear, a craft completes, an upgrade button pays off in an idle game. Play it on the item. For the character levelling up use reward.levelup; for a stat buff in battle use magic.buff; for two items merging use puzzle.merge; for a failed attempt use hit.upgradefail.

effects.name: reward.wheel
effects.whenToUse: A prize wheel, lucky spin, roulette or daily-spin wheel stops on a prize. Play it at the centre of the wheel when it stops. For a slot-machine jackpot or a huge payout use reward.jackpot; for a single coin use pickup.coin.

effects.name: move.jump
effects.whenToUse: A character jumps, lands, or starts running. Play at the feet. Also a soft landing for a dropped object.

effects.name: move.footstep
effects.whenToUse: Each footstep of a walking character, a hoof, a paw; tiny and quick. For continuous running use move.dust instead.

effects.name: move.land
effects.whenToUse: A big landing, a ground pound, a heavy object dropped, a stomp. Wider and flatter than move.jump.

effects.name: move.dash
effects.whenToUse: A dodge, a dash, a blink or a sudden burst of speed. The streaks fly BACKWARD, opposite to the dash: in 2D set dir (degrees, default left = dashing right); in 3D pass direction: [x, y, z] (the opposite of the movement).

effects.name: move.splash
effects.whenToUse: Something falls into or jumps out of water, a puddle is stepped in, a boat hits a wave. Play at the water surface.

effects.name: move.teleport
effects.whenToUse: A character teleports, blinks, warps in or out, or is summoned. Play at both the start and the end point.

effects.name: move.spawn
effects.whenToUse: An enemy, item or character appears or respawns, a block is placed, a building finishes. Gentle and quick.

effects.name: move.trail
effects.whenToUse: A dash, a speeding car, a thrown ball, a flying character or a dragged item. Start it with follow, stop it when the move ends.

effects.name: move.dust
effects.whenToUse: A character or vehicle is running or driving on the ground. Follow the feet or wheels; stop when they stop.

effects.name: move.speed
effects.whenToUse: Something is moving very fast: a sprint, a boost, a falling player, a racing car. Lines stream backward: in 2D set dir (degrees, default left); in 3D pass direction: [x, y, z] (opposite to the movement) and keep it current with handle.aim(v) while the character turns.

effects.name: move.swim
effects.whenToUse: A character or fish is swimming or diving. Follow the body; stop when it leaves the water.

effects.name: move.fly
effects.whenToUse: A bird, bee, dragon or winged character is flying or hovering. Follow the body; stop on landing.

effects.name: move.skid
effects.whenToUse: A car drifts or brakes hard, a character slides to a stop, a cart skids. Follow the wheels; stop when grip returns.

effects.name: move.doublejump
effects.whenToUse: A double jump, an air jump, a wing flap or a mid-air dash start in a platformer. Play it at the character's feet at the moment of the jump. For a jump off the ground use move.jump.

effects.name: move.wallslide
effects.whenToUse: A character slides down a wall, clings to a wall, grinds along a rail or scrapes along a surface in a platformer. Follow the hand or foot touching the wall; stop it when they let go. Tint it for the wall (stone dust, snow, sparks on metal).

effects.name: move.bounce
effects.whenToUse: A trampoline, spring, jump pad, mushroom or bouncy surface launches the character up. Play it on the pad at the moment of the bounce.

effects.name: move.blink
effects.whenToUse: A quick, glitchy short-range blink that stutters in and out: a phase blink, a ghost or spirit flickering to a new spot, a hacker or glitch power, a sci-fi phase shift, a dark hop behind an enemy. Play it at both the start and the end point. For a ninja vanishing in a cloud of dark smoke use move.shadowstep; for a bright magical warp use move.teleport; for a dash with speed streaks use move.dash.

effects.name: move.blinkstrike
effects.whenToUse: A dash attack that zips straight through enemies: an assassin's blink strike, a lightning-fast sword dash, a teleport slash, a charge that hits everything in a line. Play it where the dash starts; the streak runs about 250 px forward: in 2D set dir (degrees, the way the hero dashes, default right), in 3D pass direction. For a plain dodge or dash without a hit use move.dash; for a teleport in place use move.teleport.

effects.name: move.breach
effects.whenToUse: A whale, dolphin, shark or big fish leaps out of the sea, or a sea monster, kraken or submarine bursts up through the surface. Play it on the water surface where it comes out. For a diver going in use move.dive; for something falling in use move.splash (small) or explosion.water (big).

effects.name: move.climb
effects.whenToUse: A character climbs a wall, a cliff, a ladder, a rope, a vine or a tree trunk, or scrambles up a rock face; follow the hands while they climb and stop it when they stop or reach the top (tint it for the surface: snow, wood, moss), and use move.wallslide for sliding down a wall, move.ledge for grabbing the top edge.

effects.name: move.dig
effects.whenToUse: Something burrows or tunnels under the ground while it moves: a mole, a worm or sandworm, a tunnelling machine, a buried monster sneaking up, a dog digging for a bone, treasure being dug up. Follow the spot on the ground above it; stop it when it surfaces (then play move.emerge). For a single shovel hit use hit.dirt; for a drill boring into rock use gather.drill. Tint it for sand or snow.

effects.name: move.dive
effects.whenToUse: A character, bird or object dives head-first into water: a diving-board or cliff jump, a seabird plunging for a fish, a player jumping into a pool, lake or the sea, a submarine going under. Play it on the water surface where it goes in. For a belly-flop or anything just dropping in use move.splash; for something huge use explosion.water.

effects.name: move.dodge
effects.whenToUse: A character quickly sidesteps or dodges an attack, hopping a short way to the side and leaving an afterimage: play it on the character's centre where it stood and set dir to the way it dodges (degrees, default right; direction: [x, y, z] in 3D), and for a long fast dash or blink use move.dash instead.

effects.name: move.emerge
effects.whenToUse: A monster, zombie, worm, mole or plant bursts up out of the ground: an enemy spawning from below, a sprout shooting up, a buried treasure or boss surfacing, the end of a move.dig tunnel. Play it on the ground at the spot. For a gentle pop-in use move.spawn; for an earth spell use magic.earth; for undead rising with ghost flames use magic.raise. Tint it for sand or snow.

effects.name: move.feathers
effects.whenToUse: A bird flaps hard, takes off, is startled or gets hit: a chicken spooked on a farm, a pigeon scattering, a bird bumped in a flappy game, a pillow fight. Play it on the bird; tint it to the feather colour. For a bird that keeps flying use move.fly; for feathers floating over the whole screen use env.feathers.

effects.name: move.glide
effects.whenToUse: A character glides or soars without flapping: a hang glider, a wingsuit, a cape or leaf glide, a paper plane, a bird or dragon riding the wind; follow the body and stop it on landing (in 2D dir is the way the streaks trail, default 180 = behind a glider flying right; in 3D pass direction pointing backward and keep it current with handle.aim(v)), and use move.fly for flapping wings, move.speed for plain speed lines.

effects.name: move.groundpound
effects.whenToUse: A character drops out of the air in a ground pound, a butt stomp, a dive slam or a plunge attack and smashes into the floor in a platformer; play it once at the feet on impact, and use move.land for an ordinary heavy landing, hit.stomp for jumping on an enemy's head, hit.heavy for a hammer or boss slam.

effects.name: move.hatch
effects.whenToUse: An egg hatches or cracks open: a pet, chick, dino or dragon is born, a monster egg in a collection game, a surprise egg revealing its prize, a cocoon bursting. Play it at the egg's centre as the creature appears. Tint it with the shell colour. For a chest or gift box opening use reward.chest; for collecting an egg use gather.egg.

effects.name: move.jetpack
effects.whenToUse: A character flies or hovers with a jetpack, rocket boots or jump jets: follow the character's feet, or an empty object at the nozzles, while it thrusts (never the body's centre, which hides the flames inside a 3D model; in 2D dir is the way the flames point, in degrees, default -90 = down; in 3D pass direction and keep it aimed with handle.aim(v)) and stop it when the thrust stops; for a car or kart boost use vehicle.nitro, for a flying rocket or missile use weapon.rocket.

effects.name: move.landing
effects.whenToUse: A spaceship, lander, rocket, drone or hovering mech touches down on a planet, a moon or a landing pad: play it at the feet / landing legs at the moment of touchdown (tint it for the ground: grey moon dust, red Mars sand); for a character landing from a jump use move.land, for a car landing use vehicle.jump.

effects.name: move.ledge
effects.whenToUse: A character grabs a ledge, hangs from a cliff edge, pulls up onto a platform or lands on a narrow edge or beam that crumbles a little; play it once at the hands (or feet) on the edge, and use move.jump or move.land for landing on open ground.

effects.name: move.orbit
effects.whenToUse: Something small circles a character or object: a companion drone or satellite, an orbiting shield orb, a pet fairy light, an electron around an atom, a power-up orbiting the player; follow the character and stop it when the orbiter is gone (it circles in the screen plane in 2D and level around the body in 3D); for a whole ring of rocks around a planet use world.planetring, for stars circling a dazed head use state.stun.

effects.name: move.parachute
effects.whenToUse: A parachute, a paraglider, an umbrella, a hang glider or a cape opens to slow a fall: a skydiver or a battle-royale drop deploying the chute, a supply crate's chute popping, a floaty umbrella jump; play it once on the canopy as it opens, then use move.glide while gliding.

effects.name: move.pounce
effects.whenToUse: An animal springs off the ground: a cat pouncing on a toy, a frog or bunny hopping, a puppy leaping at a ball, a fox diving. Play it at the feet at the moment of the leap; aim the action lines along the leap with dir (degrees, default straight up) in 2D or direction: [x, y, z] in 3D. Tint it for snow, sand or mud. For a character's ordinary jump use move.jump; for a spring or trampoline use move.bounce.

effects.name: move.roll
effects.whenToUse: A character does a combat roll, a dodge roll, a forward roll or a tumble along the ground: play it on the ground where the roll starts and set dir to the way it rolls (degrees, default right; direction: [x, y, z] in 3D), and for dust while running use move.dust instead.

effects.name: move.rustle
effects.whenToUse: A character walks, runs, rolls or dives through a bush, a hedge, a pile of leaves or tall grass, or something shakes a bush: hiding in grass, a stealth game, a farm or forest level, searching a bush for an item. Play it on the bush each time it is disturbed; tint it orange for autumn leaves. For chopping a tree use gather.wood; for dust from running use move.dust; for picking a crop use gather.harvest.

effects.name: move.shadowstep
effects.whenToUse: A ninja, rogue or assassin vanishes or appears in a quick burst of dark smoke: a shadow step, a stealth vanish, an assassin slipping behind an enemy, a vampire turning to mist; play it on the body at both ends of the move (for a thick grey smoke bomb use explosion.smokebomb, for a glitchy digital blink use move.blink, for a bright magical teleport use move.teleport, for a white cartoon poof use explosion.puff).

effects.name: move.shake
effects.whenToUse: A wet animal shakes itself dry: a dog out of a bath or a lake, a duck fluffing off water, a pet caught in the rain, a character shaking off water or snow. Play it on the body; tint it brown for mud or white for snow. For staying wet over time use state.wet; for jumping into water use move.splash.

effects.name: move.skate
effects.whenToUse: A character skates or slides on ice: figure skating, ice hockey, a slippery ice level, a penguin belly slide, a snowboard or skis carving fresh snow; follow the feet and stop it when they leave the ice (in 2D dir is the way the spray flies behind the blade, default 170 degrees for skating to the right, and the chips arc up from it; in 3D pass direction pointing backward), and use move.slide for sliding on dirt or grass, move.skid for braking to a stop.

effects.name: move.slide
effects.whenToUse: A character slides along the ground on purpose: a slide under an obstacle in a runner, a baseball slide into base, a slide-tackle, a crouch slide or a belly slide; follow the feet while it lasts and stop it when they stand up (in 2D dir is the way the dust flies, default 160 degrees for a slide to the right; in 3D pass direction pointing backward), and use move.skid for a car or a character braking to a stop, hit.tackle for the moment two players collide.

effects.name: move.surf
effects.whenToUse: A character rides a board or skis on water: surfing a wave, wakeboarding, water-skiing, a kite surfer, a hoverboard skimming a lake, a character or animal sliding across water; follow the tail of the board at the water line and stop it when they fall or stop (in 2D dir is the way the spray flies, default 125 degrees = up and back for a rider going right; in 3D pass direction pointing back and well up, about 45 degrees), and use vehicle.wake for the foam trail of a boat or jet ski, move.splash for a single splash.

effects.name: move.sweep
effects.whenToUse: Sweeping, brushing or wiping something clean: a broom stroke in a cleaning or house game, dusting a shelf, clearing snow or leaves, brushing dirt off a find. Play it where the broom meets the floor for each stroke; in 2D set dir (degrees, default right), in 3D pass direction, the way the stroke pushes. For running dust use move.dust; for the sparkle when it is clean use reward.clean.

effects.name: move.swing
effects.whenToUse: A character swings on a rope, a vine, a grappling hook, a web line or a monkey bar, or anything makes a big whooshing arc through the air; play it once on the character as the swing starts (dir 0 = swinging to the right, the default, 180 = to the left; the arc always faces the camera, so a 3D game passes dir too, not direction), and use hit.slash for a weapon swing that hits something, move.dash for a straight burst of speed.

effects.name: move.wallkick
effects.whenToUse: A character kicks off a wall in a wall jump, springs off a pillar or a tree trunk, or rebounds off the side of a shaft in a platformer; play it once where the feet leave the wall, aimed away from the wall (in 2D dir in degrees, default 0 = the wall is on the left; in 3D pass direction, the wall's outward normal), and use move.wallslide for sliding down the wall before the kick, move.doublejump for a jump in open air.

effects.name: move.warp
effects.whenToUse: A spaceship jumps to hyperspace, a robot or hero warps out, a portal swallows someone, a level-exit jump in a space game: play it where the ship or character was, with dir in 2D (degrees, default 90 = up, the way it leaves) or direction in 3D; for a short magic blink in and out use move.teleport.

effects.name: magic.heal
effects.whenToUse: Health restored, a potion drunk, a shrine touched, a buff applied. Play on the character.

effects.name: magic.ice
effects.whenToUse: An ice spell hits, something freezes or shatters, a frost trap triggers, an ice block breaks.

effects.name: magic.lightning
effects.whenToUse: A lightning spell, a thunder strike, an electric trap or a shock hit. The bolt comes down from above the point.

effects.name: magic.shield
effects.whenToUse: A shield, barrier or block activates, an attack is deflected, armour absorbs a hit. For a lasting bubble use state.shield.

effects.name: magic.poison
effects.whenToUse: A poison attack, an acid splash, a toxic barrel breaks, a swamp bubble pops. For an ongoing poisoned status use state.poison.

effects.name: magic.dark
effects.whenToUse: A curse, a shadow attack, a necromancer spell, a ghost appearing, something evil activating.

effects.name: magic.holy
effects.whenToUse: A blessing, a revive, an angel or shrine, a holy attack, a character ascending. Rays shine upward from the point.

effects.name: magic.portal
effects.whenToUse: A portal, warp gate, level exit, summoning circle or teleporter that stays open. Stop it when it closes.

effects.name: magic.cast
effects.whenToUse: A character charges or casts a spell, an item is being crafted or upgraded, a machine powers up. Stop it when the spell fires.

effects.name: magic.fire
effects.whenToUse: A fireball, a flaming arrow, a meteor or any burning projectile while it flies. Play with follow on the projectile; stop it on impact and play explosion.fireball.

effects.name: magic.summon
effects.whenToUse: A creature, ally or boss is summoned; a ritual completes; a big spell is cast from a circle. Play at the feet.

effects.name: magic.curse
effects.whenToUse: A curse, hex, debuff or drain lands on a character; a cursed item is picked up. Play on the body.

effects.name: magic.buff
effects.whenToUse: A character gets stronger: attack up, defence up, speed up, a blessing, a potion that raises a stat, a party buff in an RPG. Play it on the character; tint by stat (red attack, blue defence, green speed, gold all). For healing use magic.heal.

effects.name: magic.debuff
effects.whenToUse: A character gets weaker: attack down, defence down, slowed, weakened, cursed for a stat, a bad status in an RPG. Play it on the character; tint by stat. For an ongoing curse use magic.curse or state.poison.

effects.name: magic.meteor
effects.whenToUse: A meteor, comet or fiery boulder falls from the sky onto a spot: a meteor spell, an airstrike, a falling star attack, an asteroid in space. Play it at the impact point; the fall takes half a second before the hit.

effects.name: magic.tornado
effects.whenToUse: A tornado, whirlwind, wind spell, cyclone or dust devil: a wind attack that stays, a storm hazard, a spinning move. Play it on the ground (follow it if it moves); stop it when it dies down.

effects.name: magic.earth
effects.whenToUse: An earth or rock spell: stone spikes erupting, a quake attack, ground rising, a golem stomp, a trap of spikes. Play it on the ground where it erupts.

effects.name: magic.beam
effects.whenToUse: A charged beam attack: a kamehameha, a laser cannon, a mana beam, a dragon's ray, a mech's energy blast. Play it at the hands or barrel; in 2D set dir (degrees, 0 = right), in 3D pass direction. It charges for 0.25 s, fires for 0.5 s.

effects.name: magic.blackhole
effects.whenToUse: A gravity well or vortex that pulls things in: a black hole spell, a singularity grenade, a void portal, a whirlpool, a space hazard. Play it at the centre and stop it when it collapses (then play explosion.magic).

effects.name: magic.revive
effects.whenToUse: A character comes back to life or is fully restored: a resurrection, a revive item, a second chance, a respawn with blessing, an angel's blessing. Play it at the character's feet. For ordinary healing use magic.heal.

effects.name: magic.nature
effects.whenToUse: A nature, plant or druid spell: growing a plant, a forest blessing, a vine attack, a healing grove, summoning flowers, a spring arrives. Play it on the target or the ground. For pure healing use magic.heal.

effects.name: magic.time
effects.whenToUse: Time is bent: a slow-motion power, a time stop, a rewind, a haste or slow spell, a clock power-up, extra time added in a timed level. Play it on the caster or the centre of the screen.

effects.name: magic.barrier
effects.whenToUse: A hero throws up a quick energy wall: a barrier or block ability, a projectile-blocking shield wall, a deflect skill in a MOBA or hero shooter. Play it just in front of the character, toward the attack. For a shield popping on around the character use magic.shield; for a shield that lasts use state.shield or state.dome; for a weapon parry use hit.parry.

effects.name: magic.charge
effects.whenToUse: A hero holds to charge a big energy attack: an energy ball growing in the hands, a hold-and-release special, a super punch winding up, a boss gathering power for a blast. Play it at the hands (follow it) and stop it when the attack fires, then play the attack (magic.beam fits). For a bow or gun charging its shot use weapon.chargebow; for gentle spell casting or crafting use magic.cast.

effects.name: magic.clone
effects.whenToUse: A hero makes copies of itself: a shadow clone, a decoy or mirror image, an illusion skill, a hologram double in a MOBA or ninja game. Play it once on the hero; the two puffs appear about 60 px to each side, where the copies pop in. For one character vanishing or appearing use move.teleport; for summoning a creature use magic.summon.

effects.name: magic.drain
effects.whenToUse: Life or energy is drained out of a character: a vampire bite, a life-steal or soul-drain spell, a leech attack, a necromancer sapping health, a draining curse ticking; play it on the victim's body (for a curse or debuff landing use magic.curse, for health coming back use magic.heal).

effects.name: magic.gust
effects.whenToUse: A gust or blast of wind is pushed forward: a wind spell, a push-back or knockback attack, a giant fan or leaf blower, a dragon's wing beat, a wind cannon; play it at the hands or mouth, in 2D set dir (degrees, 0 = right) and in 3D pass direction (for a standing whirlwind use magic.tornado, for wind across the whole level use env.wind).

effects.name: magic.heallaura
effects.whenToUse: A healing area on the ground that units stand in: a healing totem or shrine, a medic tent, a support tower's heal radius, a heal-circle spell, a healing spring. Play it at the zone's centre on the ground, size it to the zone and stop it when the zone ends. For one character healing over time use state.regen; for a one-off heal use magic.heal.

effects.name: magic.leap
effects.whenToUse: A hero launches into a big powered leap: a jump-attack take-off, a super jump, a leap skill in a MOBA or action RPG, a mech boosting off the ground. Play it on the ground at the feet as the hero takes off. For an ordinary jump use move.jump; for the slam when it lands use hit.heavy or magic.shockwave.

effects.name: magic.mark
effects.whenToUse: The moment an ability marks or locks onto an enemy: a hunter's mark landing, a sniper or missile lock-on, a focus-fire call, a bounty or death mark applied, an enemy tagged in a hero shooter. Play it once on the enemy (follow it if it moves). For a mark that stays over the head until it ends use state.marked; for a ring under a selected unit use state.selected.

effects.name: magic.missile
effects.whenToUse: A magic bolt or arcane missile is flying: a wizard's magic missile, a wand or staff shot, a homing mana orb, a fairy's spark, an enchanted arrow in flight; play it with follow on the projectile, stop it on impact and play explosion.magic with the same tint (for a fireball use magic.fire, for a gun or blaster bolt use weapon.laser).

effects.name: magic.raise
effects.whenToUse: The undead rise out of the ground: a zombie or skeleton climbs out of a grave, a necromancer raises minions, a ghost enemy spawns from the earth, a horror boss emerges. Play it on the ground at the feet of whatever rises. For a holy comeback use magic.revive; for a summoning circle use magic.summon; for a mole, worm or monster bursting out of plain dirt with no magic use move.emerge.

effects.name: magic.rune
effects.whenToUse: A magic circle glows on the ground and stays: a spell zone or area-of-effect marker, a summoning or ritual circle, a hidden magic trap or glyph on the floor, a wizard channelling a spell; play it at the feet or on the ground and stop it when the spell ends (for a one-shot summon burst use magic.summon, for a teleporter pad use world.teleporter, for a gate to walk through use magic.portal, for a unit selection marker use state.selected).

effects.name: magic.shockwave
effects.whenToUse: A hero's ground-slam ability: a shockwave stomp, an area knock-back skill, a seismic slam in a MOBA or action RPG, a boss's pulse that hits everything around it. Play it on the ground at the caster's feet. For a physical hammer or body slam with flying rocks use hit.heavy; for an energy blast in mid-air use explosion.shockwave.

effects.name: magic.starfall
effects.whenToUse: Stars rain down from the sky onto an area: a starfall or star-shower spell, a celestial area attack, a wish or blessing falling on a field, a magical bombardment of a zone; play it at the centre of the area on the ground (for one big rock from the sky use magic.meteor, for a calm night sky with shooting stars use env.meteors).

effects.name: magic.transform
effects.whenToUse: A character or object magically changes form: a polymorph into a frog, a shapeshift or werewolf turn, a costume or skin change, a monster evolving, a magic makeover; play it on the body and swap the model about 0.15 s in, while the smoke hides it (for a plain vanish use explosion.puff, for a teleport use move.teleport).

effects.name: magic.ultimate
effects.whenToUse: A hero's ultimate ability goes off: the big ult in a MOBA or hero shooter, a super move, a limit break, a final smash, a screen-wide special. Play it on the hero (or where the ult lands). Bigger and longer than any hit; for an explosion with fire and smoke use explosion.big or explosion.nuke, for a level-up use reward.levelup.

effects.name: magic.warcry
effects.whenToUse: A warrior lets out a war cry or battle shout that pumps up the team: a rallying roar, a berserker or orc shout, a viking horn before a charge, a commander yelling "charge!" in an RPG, strategy or brawler game. Play it on the shouting character (at the feet); red-orange by default, tint it for other teams. For a quiet stat boost use magic.buff; for a lasting angry state use state.rage; for troops staying inspired afterwards use state.rally.

effects.name: magic.wave
effects.whenToUse: A wave of water surges forward once: a tidal wave or water spell, a water cannon or fire-hose blast, a wave crashing across a deck, a splash attack; play it at the caster, in 2D set dir (degrees, 0 = right) and in 3D pass direction (for waves that keep crashing on a shore or rocks use world.wave, for a water bomb bursting in place use explosion.water, for something falling into water use move.splash).

effects.name: state.stun
effects.whenToUse: A character or enemy is stunned, dizzy or knocked out. Play above the head with follow, stop when they recover.

effects.name: state.poison
effects.whenToUse: A character or enemy is poisoned or sick. Play on the body with follow; stop when it wears off.

effects.name: state.burning
effects.whenToUse: A character, enemy, torch, campfire or object is burning. Play on it with follow; stop when the fire goes out.

effects.name: state.frozen
effects.whenToUse: A character or enemy is frozen, slowed or chilled. Play on the body with follow; stop when it thaws.

effects.name: state.shield
effects.whenToUse: A character has an active shield, barrier, invincibility or bubble. Follow the character; stop when it breaks. Combine with magic.shield for the pop-on and hit.impact for hits.

effects.name: state.rage
effects.whenToUse: A character is angry, enraged, berserk or powered up with a damage boost. Follow the head; stop when it ends.

effects.name: state.regen
effects.whenToUse: Health regenerates over time, a healing zone is active, a medic aura. Follow the character; stop when healing ends. For a one-off heal use magic.heal.

effects.name: state.sparkle
effects.whenToUse: Something wants attention: a collectible on the map, a ready reward, a new item, a rare enemy, a clickable object. Follow it; stop when it is taken.

effects.name: state.smoke
effects.whenToUse: A damaged vehicle, machine or building smokes; a chimney; a snuffed candle; something overheating. Follow it; stop when repaired.

effects.name: state.love
effects.whenToUse: A pet is happy, a character is in love or charmed, a customer is satisfied, a plant is thriving. Follow the head; stop when the mood ends.

effects.name: state.sleep
effects.whenToUse: A character or pet is asleep, resting, idle for a long time, or knocked out cold. Follow the head; stop on waking.

effects.name: state.invisible
effects.whenToUse: A character is invisible, cloaked, a ghost, or phasing. Follow the body (draw the character at low opacity yourself); stop when visible again.

effects.name: state.charged
effects.whenToUse: A character is electrified, stunned by a shock, or carrying a charged power. Also a live wire or a generator. Follow it; stop when it discharges.

effects.name: state.dome
effects.whenToUse: A force field, energy dome or barrier shield goes up around a character, a base or an object and stays until it is switched off. Play it at the feet / on the ground; call stop() and the dome breaks apart on its own (state.domebreak).

effects.name: state.domebreak
effects.whenToUse: An energy dome or force field is switched off or destroyed. Played automatically when state.dome is stopped; play it yourself only for a dome the game drew itself.

effects.name: state.magnet
effects.whenToUse: A magnet, vacuum or attract power-up is active: endless runners, coin collectors, auto-pickup buffs, a gravity field. Follow the character; stop it when the power-up runs out.

effects.name: state.rainbow
effects.whenToUse: The player is invincible or super-powered for a short time: a star power-up, a fever or rush mode, a rainbow road, a hyper state. Follow the character; stop it when the power ends. For a calm magical sparkle use state.sparkle.

effects.name: state.selected
effects.whenToUse: A unit, hero, building or target is selected or targeted: RTS and tactics selection, the active character in a turn-based fight, a locked-on enemy, a placed tower. Play it at the unit's feet and stop it on deselect. Tint green for own units, red for enemies.

effects.name: state.aura
effects.whenToUse: A character is powered up and blazing with energy: a super mode, a rage or limit break, a charged-up fighter, a boss phase two, a hero glowing with power. Follow the character (at the feet); stop it when the power ends. Tint it for the power's colour.

effects.name: state.electrified
effects.whenToUse: A character or object is charged with electricity or being shocked over time: stunned by a taser, standing in electric water, an overloaded robot, a powered-up machine, a lightning buff. Follow it; stop it when it ends.

effects.name: state.wet
effects.whenToUse: A character is soaking wet: just out of the water, caught in rain, hit by a water attack, slimed, sweating from heat, a wet dog. Follow the character; stop it after a few seconds when they are dry.

effects.name: state.bleeding
effects.whenToUse: A character keeps losing health over time from a wound: bleeding damage, a cut, a damage-over-time status, critically hurt. Follow the wound or the body; stop it when healed. Tint it for other fluids (green for aliens, black for oil).

effects.name: state.sad
effects.whenToUse: A character is sad, gloomy, sulking or unlucky: a pet that is unhappy, a lost game, a bad mood, a funny moment of bad luck. Follow the character's head; stop it when they cheer up.

effects.name: state.music
effects.whenToUse: A character sings, dances, plays an instrument or listens to music: a radio or jukebox playing, a happy humming pet, a rhythm game, a bard's song. Follow the head or the music source; stop it when the music stops.

effects.name: state.sweat
effects.whenToUse: A cartoon moment of nerves, effort or embarrassment: a close call, a hard push, panic, a puzzle that is tricky, a character caught out, heat. Play it at the head; repeat it while the effort lasts.

effects.name: state.happy
effects.whenToUse: A quick happy reaction: a pet is petted or fed, a character likes a gift, a villager is pleased, a correct choice in a dating or care game. Play it at the head. For a lasting in-love state use state.love.

effects.name: state.angry
effects.whenToUse: A character is cross, annoyed or fuming in a cartoon way: a grumpy pet, an impatient customer, a villager who was bumped, a boss losing its temper, a player who failed again. Follow the head; stop it when they calm down. For a combat rage or berserk damage buff use state.rage.

effects.name: state.charmed
effects.whenToUse: A character is charmed, hypnotised or mind-controlled for a while: a charm spell, a siren's song, an enemy turned to fight on your side, a love potion that makes them follow you. Play it over the head with follow; stop it when the charm breaks. For a happy or in-love pet use state.love; for dark, evil possession use state.possessed; for dizzy circling stars use state.stun.

effects.name: state.cloak
effects.whenToUse: A character uses active camouflage, a cloaking device or stealth tech (a spy gadget, a stealth suit in a sci-fi shooter, a cloaked robot, drone or ship): follow the body while it is cloaked (draw the character faint yourself) and stop it when it reappears; for a ghost or magic invisibility use state.invisible.

effects.name: state.cursed
effects.whenToUse: A character carries a lasting curse or hex: a cursed hero, a doom mark, a haunted item being held, a vampire's drain, a dark damage-over-time debuff. Follow the body; stop it when the curse is lifted. For the moment a curse lands use magic.curse; for a character taken over by evil use state.possessed; for a scared character use state.fear; for poison use state.poison.

effects.name: state.dance
effects.whenToUse: A character is dancing: a dance battle or dance game, a victory dance, a party guest on the dance floor, a pet wiggling to music. Play it at the character's feet with follow; stop it when the dance ends. For fever or in-the-groove mode over the head use state.groove.

effects.name: state.drunk
effects.whenToUse: A cartoon character is tipsy, drunk, woozy or confused for a while: after a funny potion or a party drink, a confusion debuff that scrambles the controls. Play it over the head with follow; stop it when they sober up. For a knock-out with stars circling the head use state.stun; for nausea or feeling sick use state.sick; for poison bubbles rising from the body use state.poison.

effects.name: state.fear
effects.whenToUse: A character is scared, terrified or panicking for a while: a fear spell, a ghost or monster frightens them, a horror moment, a cowardly enemy fleeing. Follow the body; stop it when the fear wears off. For a sudden one-off fright use state.surprise; for one quick nervous sweat use state.sweat; for a lasting curse use state.cursed.

effects.name: state.focus
effects.whenToUse: A character concentrates or takes aim: a sniper steadying a shot, an archer drawing a bow, a meditating monk, a focus or accuracy buff, a mind power gathering before it is used. Play it at the head with follow; stop it when they act. For a mark over an enemy who is being targeted use state.marked; for pondering or deciding use state.thinking; for charging up raw power use state.aura.

effects.name: state.freezing
effects.whenToUse: A character is freezing cold and shivering: out in a blizzard, a snowy level without a coat, just out of an icy lake, a cold damage-over-time, a chilly pet. Follow the body; stop it when they warm up. The breath blows right: in 2D set dir (degrees, 180 = left), in 3D pass direction: [x, y, z], the way they face. For frozen solid or slowed by ice use state.frozen.

effects.name: state.glitch
effects.whenToUse: A character, robot, enemy or object is glitching or corrupted: a hacked robot, a virus, a hologram breaking up, a cyber or computer world, a corrupted boss, a bugged NPC as a joke: follow the body and stop it when it ends (tint null keeps cyan and magenta, a tint gives one colour); for electric shocks use state.electrified, for retro pixel blasts use explosion.pixel.

effects.name: state.groove
effects.whenToUse: A character is in the groove: fever or hype mode in a rhythm game, a combo streak that keeps going, a character vibing to music, a dance-off bonus. Follow the head; stop it when the streak breaks. For plain music notes use state.music, for invincibility use state.rainbow.

effects.name: state.halo
effects.whenToUse: A character is blessed, holy or angelic for a while: an angel or saint, a blessed or sanctified status, a good-ghost spirit, a holy buff that lasts, a pure-hearted moment in a life sim; follow the head and stop it when the blessing ends (for a one-off blessing use magic.holy, for a lasting heal use state.regen).

effects.name: state.hasted
effects.whenToUse: A character is hasted or has a speed buff for a while: a haste spell, a speed potion, sprint boots, an energy drink, an attack-speed boost. Follow the body; stop it when the buff ends. For the moment a buff is cast use magic.buff; for lines streaming behind something that is actually moving fast use move.speed.

effects.name: state.haunted
effects.whenToUse: A character or object is haunted or followed by ghosts: a ghost-marked player, a haunted doll, painting or chest, a spooky villager, a spirit-bound companion. Follow the body; stop it when the haunting ends. For a dark evil aura use state.possessed; for a lasting curse or hex use state.cursed; for a scared, panicking character use state.fear.

effects.name: state.invulnerable
effects.whenToUse: A character is briefly invincible after taking a hit or respawning (mercy invincibility, i-frames, spawn protection) and blinks white. Follow the body for the one to three seconds it lasts, then stop it. For a star-power invincibility mode use state.rainbow; for a visible shield bubble use state.shield.

effects.name: state.levitate
effects.whenToUse: A character floats or hovers above the ground for a while: a levitation spell, a hover power-up, a floating wizard or ghost, anti-gravity boots, a hovering robot.
